_comment: Applied by the shell at load (screen_form_module.rs apply_overrides). Keys: field key k (label/kind/options/computed; table columns are keyed by the column's row-0 key); item:<partIndex>:<itemIndex> for item labels (0-based into forms-schema.json parts/items); table:<part>:<name> builds a schedule table from row templates; add:<part>:<item> appends bound controls the extractor left out; move:<field key> with to '<part>:<item>' or '<part>:new:<no>' (+ item {l, order}) regroups a control under its printed item. Every entry carries its evidence.

layout.evidence: PR 7: the printed sheet's parts and items in paper order (html-frozen/1701a-2018/index.html, BIR Form 1701A January 2018, and its writer-cells.json captions): items 1-3, Part I items 4-19, Part II items 20-31 with the overpayment boxes printed unnumbered after item 30, Part IV.A items 36-46 with item 42's (add more...) rows, Part IV.B items 47-56 with item 51's, Part IV.C items 57-65, and Part V (the spouse) items 66-75 (manual-1: the item 42 rows were drawn at the end of Part V). Item 5 RDO Code and item 67 the spouse's RDO, which the print fills from the draft (writer-cells joins frm1701A:txtRDOCode '5 RDO Code' and derived:spouse_rdo '67 RDO Code'), are drawn (R2.2, manual-0, preview.0). Line of Business is not on this sheet (writer-cells not_joined frm1701A:txtLineBus: 'not on the paper form: this sheet has no line-of-business box'). Part III (details of payment), which the field map never writes, stays hidden as before. Field keys, values, the official XML and the print map are unchanged.

parts.n: Part I · Background Information on Taxpayer/Filer

items.l: Taxpayer's Name (Last Name, First Name, Middle Name)
Registered Address (Indicate complete address. If the registered address is different from the current address, go to the RDO to update registered address by using BIR Form No. 1905)
Tax Due (Either from Part IV.A Item 46 OR Part IV.B Item 56)
Less: Total Tax Credits/Payments (From Part IV.C Item 64)
Net Tax Payable/(Overpayment) (Item 20 Less Item 21) (From Part IV Item 65)
Less: Portion of Tax Payable Allowed for 2nd Installment to be paid on or before October 15 (50% or less of Item 20)
Amount of Tax Payable/(Overpayment) (Item 22 Less Item 23)
Total Amount Payable/(Overpayment) (Sum of Items 24 and 28)
If overpayment, mark one (1) box only. (Once the choice is made, the same is irrevocable)

parts.n: Part IV.A · Computation of Income Tax – For Graduated Income Tax Rates

items.l: Less: Sales Returns, Allowances and Discounts
Less: Allowable Deduction - Optional Standard Deduction (OSD) (40% of Item 38)
Amount Received/Share in Income by a Partner from General Professional Partnership (GPP)
Total Other Income (Sum of Items 41 to 43)
Total Taxable Income (Sum of Items 40 and 44)
TAX DUE (Item 45 x Applicable Tax Rate based on Tax Table below) (To Part II – Item 20)

parts.n: Part IV.B · Computation of Income Tax – For 8% Income Tax Rate

items.l: Less: Sales Returns, Allowances and Discounts
Total Other Non-operating Income (Sum of Items 50 and 51)
Total Taxable Income (Sum of Items 49 and 52)
Less: Allowable reduction from gross sales/receipts and other non-operating income of PURELY self-employed individuals and/or professionals in the amount of P 250,000
TAX DUE (Item 55 x 8% Income Tax Rate) (To Part II - Item 20)
Tax Payments for the First Three (3) Quarters
Creditable Tax Withheld for the First Three (3) Quarters
Creditable Tax Withheld per BIR Form No. 2307 for the 4th Quarter
Tax Paid in Return Previously Filed, if this is an Amended Return
Total Tax Credits/Payments (Sum of Items 57 to 63) (To Item 21)
Net Tax Payable/(Overpayment) (Item 46 OR 56 Less Item 64) (To Part II - Item 22)

parts.n: Part V · Background Information on Spouse

items.l: Spouse's Name (Last Name, First Name, Middle Name)

layout.evidence: PR 7: the printed sheet's parts and items in paper order (html-frozen/1701ms-2024/index.html, BIR Form 1701-MS August 2024, and its writer-cells.json captions): items 1-5, Part I items 6-18 in columns A (taxpayer/filer) and B (spouse), Part II items 19-35, Part IV.A items 1-4, IV.B1 items 5-18B, IV.B2 items 19-25, Part V items 1-10 and Part VI item 1. Each box is the item the print fills from it: form_1701ms.rs `page_amounts` pairs every amount control with the draft field `print_amounts` prints under that item (R3.0-R3.3, manual-1: Part V's boxes had been merged into Part IV items of the same number). Item 4 Civil Status is the page's select, which the sheet prints in its item 4 box (derived:civil_status '4 Civil Status'). The page 2 header copies, the page counter and Part III (details of payment, which the model does not hold) stay hidden. Field keys, values, the official XML and the print map are unchanged. Item 6 is drawn as two TIN combs, column A and column B, each the sheet's 3-3-3-5 boxes (html-frozen/1701ms-2024/index.html '6 Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN)' over 'A. Taxpayer/Filer' and 'B. Spouse') (R5.0).

layout.evidence: PR 8: the printed sheet's parts and item numbers. Structure and captions from html-frozen/1702ex-2018/index.html (BIR Form 1702-EX January 2018: items 1-5, Part I 6-17, Part II 18-23, Part III 24-27, page 2 Parts IV 28-51 and V 52-54, page 3 Part VI Schedules 1-3) and html-frozen/1702ex-2018/writer-cells.json joins (which box prints at which item; amounts print through derived:amount:<control>). Item 7 is hdnPg1Pt1I7RDO, the RDO the sheet prints; the overpayment choice sits under item 22, where the sheet prints it. Items 8 and 9 are one box each: the draft keeps one registered name and one registered address (form_1702ex.rs registered_name, registered_address), the field map cuts them into the official 60- and 80-character lines and the print shapes them over the sheet's combs (derived:name_line1-3, derived:address_line1-3), so the cut lines are not drawn. The page 2 and 3 header copies (TIN, name), the page counter and the (more...) pop-ups' counters and subtotals are not drawn. The signatories' title and TIN and Part III are disabled at load in the official program (rules/forms/1702ex-v2018c/fixtures/runtime-control-inventory-v796.json source lines 948-989 and 1031-1152) and the model does not hold them (writer-cells rule: 'Part III Details of Payment (the model does not hold them)'), so each printed item shows a note. Field keys, values, the official XML and the print map are unchanged.

layout.evidence: PR 8: the printed sheet's parts and item numbers. Structure and captions from html-frozen/1702mx-2018c/index.html (BIR Form 1702-MX January 2018: items 1-5, Part I 6-13, Part II 14-22 and the signature block, Part III 23-26, then Part IV Schedules 1 to 10 on pages 2-4, each with its own items and its A. Exempt / B. Special / C. Regular / D. Total columns) and html-frozen/1702mx-2018c/writer-cells.json joins (which box prints at which item and column). Item 7 is drpPg1Pt1I7RDO, the RDO the sheet prints (writer-cells joins it at '7 RDO Code'; txtPg1Pt1I7RDO is its duplicate). Item 10 is txtPg1Pt1I8, the date of incorporation (writer-cells: '10 Date of Incorporation/Organization (MM/DD/YYYY)'). The page 2-4 header copies (TIN, branch, name), the Attachment M annex boxes the four-page sheet has no pages for, the page counters and the (Add more...) counters and subtotals are not drawn (writer-cells not_joined, and no join for the subtotals). The signatories' boxes and Part III are disabled at load in the official program (rules/forms/1702mx-v2018c/fixtures/runtime-control-inventory-v796.json source lines 934-975 and 1014-1093) and this app never writes them, so each printed item shows a note.
